tagline: Regional bank providing comprehensive financial services across the Mid-Atlantic region
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest income (FTE) is the primary revenue driver for a regional bank, reflecting net interest margin and loan portfolio quality adjusted for differences in tax treatment

kpis.name: Net Interest Income (FTE)
kpis.explanation: Net interest income adjusted for tax-equivalent basis (FTE adjustment reflects tax treatment differences on tax-exempt income sources)
kpis.description: Net interest income adjusted for differences in tax treatment of interest income sources
kpis.signal: Net interest income increased significantly year-over-year

kpis.name: Tangible Common Equity
kpis.explanation: Common equity adjusted for goodwill and amortizable intangibles, excluding perpetual preferred stock
kpis.description: Common equity adjusted for goodwill and intangible assets
kpis.signal: Tangible common equity increased significantly year-over-year

kpis.name: Tangible Common Equity Ratio
kpis.explanation: Tangible common equity as a percentage of tangible assets, a key capital adequacy metric
kpis.description: Ratio of tangible common equity to tangible assets

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin (FTE)
kpis.explanation: Net interest income on a tax-equivalent basis divided by average earning assets, a key profitability metric
kpis.description: Net interest margin on a tax-equivalent basis

kpis.name: Sandy Spring Acquisition Impact
kpis.explanation: Completed acquisition of Sandy Spring Bancorp on April 1, 2025, adding over 50 branches in Virginia, Maryland, and Washington D.C.
kpis.description: Total assets reached $37.6 billion at year-end 2025 following Sandy Spring integration
kpis.signal: Total assets increased significantly through acquisition and organic growth

kpis.name: CRE Loan Sale Gain
kpis.explanation: Sale of performing CRE loans from Sandy Spring acquisition on June 26, 2025 with $2.0 billion unpaid principal balance
kpis.description: Pre-tax gain of $10.9 million from CRE loan sale, net of transaction expenses
kpis.signal: Strategic portfolio optimization generated pre-tax gain

risks.title: Insufficiency of Allowance for Credit Losses
risks.score_rationale: This risk is highlighted as the primary credit risk factor with strong language regarding estimation uncertainty and impact on results. It is central to the 10-K risk disclosures and reinforced by changing economic conditions. Credit risk is a highly weighted category in the financial sector.

risks.title: Exposure to Local Real Estate Market Risk
risks.score_rationale: Text emphasizes geographic concentration of real estate loans and vulnerability to local market shocks. The risk is repeated and directly linked to portfolio quality and collateral values.

risks.title: Commercial Real Estate Loan Risk
risks.score_rationale: Commercial real estate loans are identified as higher risk with significant balances and tenant cash flow dependencies. Text mentions heightened regulatory scrutiny, increasing the severity rating.

risks.title: Construction and Development Loan Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk stems from uncertainty in construction costs and future value assessments. Text emphasizes that collateral may be insufficient in case of price declines, signaling elevated concern.

risks.title: Dependence on Federal Guarantee Programs
risks.score_rationale: Risk relates to regulatory compliance and potential loss of guarantee coverage. While program-specific, it is noted as potentially material, with non-negligible exposure.

risks.title: Real Estate Valuation Inaccuracy
risks.score_rationale: Appraisal errors are cited as potentially distorting collateral values and impacting financial statements. Risk is recurring and linked to market volatility, especially during uncertain periods.

risks.title: Small and Medium Enterprise Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: Text highlights SME vulnerability to economic cycles and limited financial resources. Risk is heightened by fact that some borrowers lack crisis experience, increasing uncertainty.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing
